form:FormGroup.label: Connection URLs
form:FormGroup.helpText: URLs of the Elasticsearch nodes to connect to, one per line, in the form scheme://host:port, e.g. https://elastic.example.com:9200. If the port is left out it defaults to 80 for http and 443 for https.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: One URL per line, e.g. https://host:9200.

form:FormGroup.label: CA certificate (PEM format)
form:FormGroup.helpText: CA certificate used to verify the TLS certificates of the Elasticsearch nodes, in PEM format. Only used when a connection URL uses https. If left blank, the Java default trust store is used.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: PEM text. Only used for https URLs.

form:FormGroup.label: API key ID
form:FormGroup.helpText: ID of the Elasticsearch API key used to authenticate. Only used when 'Use authentication' is ticked and a secret is also set.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Used with the API key secret when authentication is on.

form:FormGroup.label: API key secret
form:FormGroup.helpText: Secret of the Elasticsearch API key used to authenticate. Only used when 'Use authentication' is ticked and an API key ID is also set.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Used with the API key ID when authentication is on.

form:FormGroup.label: Connection timeout (ms)
form:FormGroup.helpText: Time in milliseconds to wait for a connection to Elasticsearch. Default is 3000 (3 seconds).

form:FormGroup.label: Response timeout (ms)
form:FormGroup.helpText: Time in milliseconds to wait for a response from Elasticsearch once a request has been sent. 0 means no limit. Default is 0.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Milliseconds. 0 means no limit. Default is 0.
